items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He got me – Allen Counter from Harvard. ... He got – Allen got to them, who’s their representative, and got me in at a time when I needed it.

ctx.x: That’s the best I can come up with this morning. So Gustaf and Silvia [Queen of Sweden] presented the Polar award. It’s for a classical musician and a jazz one. It’s like a musical Nobel Prize. He got me – Allen Counter from Harvard. You know Allen, don’t you?
